hook: Platform Nine was sealed the night Elias vanished. So who left wet footprints inside?

script.text: Platform Nine was sealed the night Elias vanished. So who left wet footprints inside?
script.visual: Nora, a 29-year-old station cleaner with dark wavy hair tied low and a rust-red raincoat, stands alone before a sealed gate in a vast rain-dark station; wide low-angle frame, teal shadows and amber lamps.

script.text: Nora had cleaned this station for twenty years, still listening for his name.
script.visual: Close view of Nora's brass janitor keys and silver watch as she cleans the empty platform; her small reflection appears in wet tile, soft amber light against deep blue night.

script.text: At midnight, its dead timetable flickered and printed two tickets for tomorrow.
script.visual: The old amber timetable suddenly glows while Nora turns toward it; two blank paper tickets slide from a slot, medium over-shoulder framing, no readable text.

script.text: One carried Nora's name. The other read Elias, still thirteen.
script.visual: Nora holds two worn tickets in trembling hands, one child-sized; her face is reflected in the glass behind them, tight close-up, warm light fading into shadow.

script.text: At 12:17, a white light filled the tunnel. Nora reached out.
script.visual: Nora reaches toward a white train-like light at the far end of the tunnel, rain mist in the air, centered vertical composition and strong backlight.

script.text: The rails ended before the light. No train arrived—only wet prints crossing toward her.
script.visual: The rails visibly stop short of the glowing tunnel; fresh footprints cross the wet platform toward Nora, seen from behind her shoulder, cool blue light.

script.text: The board changed: You can go home now, Nora. She followed the footprints.
script.visual: Nora lowers the tickets and follows footprints away from the sealed platform toward a station exit warmed by dawn; medium rear view, amber light opening ahead.

script.text: They led away from the station. For the first time, she stopped looking back.
script.visual: Nora walks toward a quiet golden city street at sunrise, shoulders finally relaxed, the old station receding behind her, wide vertical composition with gentle rain reflections.
